selectionRules: Both ActiveClinic Stitch projects are authoritative; neither is optional.

productDecisionDifferences.rule: P27 patient portal register uses public project; P02 staff Register Patient* uses internal project. Do not hybridize.
P27 patient self-service profile uses public project; P02 Patient Profile Overview is staff clinical profile — internal project.
P24/P25 booking patient details use public project; P02 Edit Patient Details is authenticated clinical edit — internal project.
P27 patient portal dashboard uses public project; P01 staff dashboard uses internal project.
